newsitem.title: spain: SOCCER-LEANDRO TO ABANDON LEG-COCKING ROUTINE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LEANDRO TO ABANDON LEG-COCKING ROUTINE.

text.p: Brazilian striker Leandro, who celebrated his goals for Valencia by going down on all fours and cocking his leg like a dog, is to vary his routine because of complaints from other players.
"I will change animal," said Leandro, who has also treated Valencia fans to an imitation of a bat, the symbol of the Spanish club.
Leandro came close to blows with Atletico Madrid's Kiko after his latest leg-cocking performance in Saturday's league game.
